name: Recursive CTE for Hierarchical Organization Chart
problem_statement: Write a recursive Common Table Expression (CTE) in SQL to compute hierarchy depth, manager chain path, and direct report counts for each employee in an organization chart.
source_code:
WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        emp_id, 
        manager_id, 
        name, 
        0 AS depth, 
        CAST(name AS TEXT) AS hierarchy_path
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.emp_id, 
        e.manager_id, 
        e.name, 
        ot.depth + 1, 
        ot.hierarchy_path || ' -> ' || e.name
    FROM employees e
    JOIN org_tree ot ON e.manager_id = ot.emp_id
)
SELECT emp_id, name, depth, hierarchy_path 
FROM org_tree 
ORDER BY depth ASC, emp_id ASC;
unit_tests:
CREATE TABLE employees (
    emp_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    manager_id INTEGER,
    name TEXT NOT NULL
);
INSERT INTO employees (emp_id, manager_id, name) VALUES
(1, NULL, 'CEO'),
(2, 1, 'VP Eng'),
(3, 1, 'VP Product'),
(4, 2, 'Staff Engineer'),
(5, 4, 'Senior Engineer');
